{{Quote|The sand demon is the fiercest creature on this planet. You don't just walk into its lair and return without a scratch.|Sharack Breev|<ref name="Demon's Blood" />}}
The '''sand demon''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]], six-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] that was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Feared by all other life on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world, sand [[Demon/Legends|demons]] preyed on a wide variety of creatures, including the legendary [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]]. Sand demons often lived for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], gliding beneath the surface of the desert as though the sand was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] and boring through rock with its razor-sharp legs. Tatooine's native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] believed that sand demons devoured their victims' life essences to grow stronger with each [[Death/Legends|kill]]. Physically similar to the tentacled [[Lylek/Legends|lyleks]] native to the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], sand demons were often tracked by [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as part of the Tusken Raiders' [[Demon's Blood]] ritual, and while brave [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] occasionally sought to bring down one of the beasts, the creatures' ferocity and rarity left them shrouded in legends and myths.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Remarkable. The beast appears to have gone into hibernation and shed its skin. The amount of blood it's letting is astounding.|Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Malavai Quinn]], after witnessing a sand demon's shedding|<ref name="Demon's Blood" />}}
Sand [[Demon/Legends|demons]] were large, six-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] that ranged in size from the average height of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] to more than twice that amount.<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair" /> Native to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], sand demons possessed [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] that were situated on tall stalks on either side of their powerful, [[Tooth/Legends|tooth]]-filled [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. The bottom and top of each eye stalk was protected by [[Chitin/Legends|chitin]], while the eye itself was covered with a sand-resistant membrane. The creature's jaws allowed it to latch onto prey with a nearly unshakable grip.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Each of the sand demon's six talon-like legs were armored in chitin that ranged in color from brown<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair" /> to black, matching the wide shell that protected the sand demon's upper body. The creature's underbelly was soft and relatively unprotected,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and the unarmored parts of its body ranged in color from gold<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair" /> to a greenish-tan.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Sand demons experienced periods of hibernation, but each sand demon underwent a process of shedding its skin and profuse [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] before doing so. After awakening from hibernation, the sand demon's new skin was coated in a kind of glistening gel, similar to the kind that covered newborn sand demons.<ref name="Demon's Blood" /> The sand demon was very similar to the [[Lylek/Legends|lylek]], a six-legged predator native to the desert world of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], though the two creatures differed in that the sand demon lacked the two thick tentacles possessed by the lylek.<ref name="Ultimate">Lyleks are visually depicted in ''[[Ultimate Adversaries]]'' and appear virtually identical to sand demons apart from the lylek's [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]].</ref> According to Tatooine's native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], sand demons could live for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behavior and intelligence==
[[File:Sleeping_Sand_Demon.png|thumb|right|200px|A sleeping sand demon]]
{{Quote|That beastly predator is the only thing that hunts krayt dragons&mdash;and those are massive.|Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Hare'en]]|<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair" />}}
A [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with moderate intelligence,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> sand demons traveled beneath the desert sands in a way that natives described as "sand swimming," gliding underneath the desert's surface like it was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. They were also capable of digging through rock and sand with their talons, leaving behind tunnels and [[Cave/Legends|caves]] beneath Tatooine's surface. The creatures erupted from beneath the desert to consume their prey. Sand demons occupied the highest point of Tatooine's [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] chain, as they were the only known predator of Tatooine's enormous [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]]<ref name="Codex" />&mdash;massive lizards that averaged thirty [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length and ten in height.<ref name="Databank">{{DB|creature|kraytdragon|krayt dragon}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Now I ain't no coward; I've hunted Sand Demons on Tatooine, fought Sith during the war on Coruscant. Clearing the wildlife on Taris seemed like an easy gig.|Kord Murdok|<ref name="Knight Fall">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Knight Fall|Taris}}</ref>}}
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], sand demons were well-known among the natives of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Tatooine, though they were largely shrouded in myths and legends. Grainy [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] images and the stories of Tatooine's nomads prevented the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from dispelling sand demons as an outright myth, and almost all attempts to learn more about the creatures ended in disaster. The Tusken Raiders believed the sand demons absorbed their victims' life essence in order to strengthen themselves, and the Raiders made cave [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] of ancient sand demons that had supposedly survived for centuries through this process&mdash;sand demons that were believed to be immune to any injury.<ref name="Codex" /> The [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Kord Murdok]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] sand demons for a time on Tatooine,<ref name="Knight Fall" /> and the [[Demon's Blood]] ritual was a tradition that had existed for generations,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> though by the time of the Cold War, it was no longer well-known.<ref name="Demon's Blood" /> For the ritual, members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who were seeking enlightenment tracked a sand demon out into the deserts to anoint themselves with its blood, and those [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who successfully returned then visited the Tusken Raiders to learn their own unique path to self-discovery.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
[[File:Sand_demon_attacks.png|thumb|left|200px|A sand demon challenges intruders in its cave.]]
Several sand demons made their nest in an [[Dune Sea mining complex|abandoned mining complex]] in the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] region<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">Act I of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] storyline in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates|here]].</ref> when they were drawn to seismic vibrations generated by the Republic's stolen [[Shock Drum]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. These sand demons were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] who was seeking to shut down the Shock Drum and also rescue [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]], whom the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Praven]] had left to die in front of the weapon.<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair" />
{{Endgame}}

Around the same time, the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jaesa Willsaam]] underwent the Demon's Blood ritual by seeking out an ancient sand demon within a [[Sand Demon's Cave|cave]] in the [[Shattered Basin]] region. With the help of an explorer named [[Sharack Breev]], a [[Empire's Wrath|Sith apprentice]] later retraced Willsaam's steps during the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] [[Hunt for Jaesa Willsaam|search for Willsaam]], neutralizing the beast and performing the ritual.<ref name="Demon's Blood" /> Around [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.0}}</ref> a sand demon was affected by a [[Seeds of Rage|Seed of Rage]], a [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemical]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] planted in the northern reaches of the Dune Sea, and it underwent significant physical changes. The sand demon developed gray-black growths on its body, while the beast's eyes turned red, and its skin became covered in red energy.<ref name="Buried">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Buried Evil|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The sand demon was first introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. The creatures appear in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]-class mission "The Sand Demon's Lair," in which the player must fight through several sand demons to reach the Shock Drum in the next chamber. Players can also choose to sacrifice the [[Brrik's clan|family]] of the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Brrik]] in order to eliminate some of the sand demons, which results in [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] alignment points.<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair" /> However, as a Republic character, the Jedi Knight is assumed to only choose the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] options,<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment points.</ref> so this article likewise assumes that the Knight did not sacrifice Brrik's family.<ref name="The Sand Demon's Lair" />

[[File:Lylek.jpg|thumb|right|170px|A lylek]]
The sand demon's appearance is virtually identical to the [[Lylek/Legends|lylek]], a predator from Ryloth, though the lylek features a number of tentacles.<ref name="Ultimate" /> However, two lylek mini-pets were introduced to ''The Old Republic'' in [[March]]<ref name="Dunno">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130313-0|text=Cartel Market Shipment Two: The Contraband Packs}}</ref> and [[April]] [[2013]], and the pets utilize a recolored sand demon model to represent a lylek, though both lack the tentacles that distinguish the lylek from the sand demon.<ref name="ViceC">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130422|text=Vice Commandant's Contraband Pack}}</ref>

Another sand demon appears in the Sith Warrior-class mission "Demon's Blood," in which the player performs the Demon's Blood ritual. Depending on the choice made, the player gains either light or dark alignment points or none at all. If the player outright attacks the beast or subdues and then kills it, the player will gain dark alignment points. If the player subdues the beast and waits for it to shed, the player will gain light alignment points. If the player fails to subdue it, no alignment points are given. The game's text files reveal that the sand demon in the Sith Warrior storyline was originally planned to be a krayt dragon; the conversation file for the confrontation with the creature is labeled "ancient_krayt_dragon.txt."<ref name="Demon's Blood" /> "Sand Demon" is capitalized within the game,<ref name="Demon's Blood" /> though the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', which gives additional information on the creatures, does not.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> A sand demon also appears in the game's first digital expansion, [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], in which a sand demon is under the influence of a Seed of Rage on Tatooine.<ref name="Buried" /> Sand demons can also be summoned as combat companions in the "Done and Dusted" Uprising in Update 5.1 of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion.<ref name="Done">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Done and Dusted}}</ref>
